content.short: CoinMetrics is a DeFi tooling platform for crypto data analytics and developer APIs.
content.description: CoinMetrics is a leading provider of crypto financial intelligence, offering network data, market data, index data, and network risk solutions for institutions involved with cryptoassets. Users can use CoinMetrics' data analytics platform to perform industry research, while developers can use CoinMetrics APIs to build their own web3 analytics applications. CoinMetrics was founded in 2017 as an open-source project to determine the economic significance of public blockchains.
content.meta: CoinMetrics provides crypto financial intelligence with data on networks, markets, indexes. Discover CoinMetrics and other DeFi Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
